title: Selected Work
subtitle: AI copilot skill shipped, an AI fundraising ecosystem built end-to-end, vibe-coding onboarding co-defined with founders — selected for Fin

application.positioning: Design leader moving closer to the system and the model — CS copilot shipped, AI fundraising ecosystem built end-to-end, vibe-coding onboarding co-defined with founders, functional-craft quality bar (agentic engineering + design-system-as-API).

selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: THE most direct product-category match to Fin. Shipped MS Copilot skill for the Bibel TV CS team; single-step draft from CS handbook; escalation as a first-class output; human keeps the send decision. Different scale from Fin (internal-team tool, ~30 CS-team users, not a thousands-of-external-teams product) — but the acceptance-vs-override, handbook-as-context, and human-in-the-loop patterns are directly transferable. In-depth format to give the design decisions room and to model the MS-Copilot-platform disclosure honestly.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-fundraising: The cleanest single demonstration of 'design leader moving closer to the model' — analysis → Claude Project with follow-up-question loops → web prototype → Claude skill producing multi-surface follow-up content (in-app notifications, web banners, video scripts). Built solo end-to-end at the prompt-and-context layer. Foregrounded at equal weight to the CS copilot per verification-log delta 2026-07-09 (Q2 upgrade from 'in build' to 'shipped ecosystem'). NEW draft created by this step from bibel-tv-head-of-product-design.md:62 + verification log Q2. Screenshots + performance-data confidentiality treatment still needed before published status.
selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: Second AI proof and the sharpest 'hold your own with engineers and scientists on model behaviour' signal. Vibe-coding split-screen direct manipulation co-defined with Ninox's CEO and technical co-founder in the founder-led stealth phase. Real multi-turn / dual-path agent workflow design decision (chat + direct manipulation coexist; first-schema-is-wrong handled as normal case; suggested-actions chips propose next moves; user-agency principle 'show output, allow users to edit' explicit). Featured, in-depth. Order 3 because Bibel TV work is current-role signal.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: Quality-bar craft anchor per Fin JD's 'how things work, not just how they look' — engineering consumes prototype code directly; iteration days → hours; ~70% of AI-generated code ships. Also proves comfort in messy, ambiguous spaces (agentic engineering as design practice, introduced from zero). Browseable + executive: the two in-depth headline slots are already spent on the AI-product stories; this reinforces the functional-craft signal without over-weighting Bibel TV in the surface.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: Second functional-craft anchor — 'system behaviour enforced by infrastructure, not documentation' matches Fin's 'raises the quality bar around them' framing at the infrastructure level. Git-based token repo + Style Dictionary + three-tier hierarchy + multi-platform sync + DTCG standard. Browseable + executive to keep the surface tight; in-depth format is available under ?all for readers who go deep on infrastructure work.
selection_rationale.ninox-org-building: Peer-in-craft management + SLT parity — the closest single precedent for Fin's 'raises the bar around them' pillar as it applies to a team of Staff / Principal ICs. Ninox: 5 direct reports + design lead + SLT member + coached the design lead through a difficult engineering-lead partnership + made performance calls in both directions. Executive format keeps the framing tight — Fin JD leans product / AI ahead of org-building, and the seniority composition of the Ninox 5 is not fully documented (Priority 2 Q5 open, non-blocking) so we do NOT claim all-Staff / Principal parity in the case-study surface.
selection_rationale.churchdesk-booking-system: Speed + measurable-impact proof + regulated multi-jurisdictional environment. Dual PM / Design mandate is a real 'high-agency builder' precedent. 2-month delivery, 70% coordination-time reduction, 90% booking acceptance. Executive format because multi-stakeholder coordination is secondary here (unlike Delivery Hero where it was central); Fin's JD does not emphasise that particular capability.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-prototyping: Hidden — substantially overlaps with bibeltv-agentic-engineering. Kept behind ?all rather than surfaced twice. Also: status 'in-progress' with known AI-slop concerns from earlier reviews (per DAYONE precedent). Out of scope to fix here.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-app-redesign: Hidden — growth + retention + experimentation angle is good, but the JD does not emphasise B2C-media app growth. The agentic-engineering and design-system-API case studies already carry the Bibel TV technical depth signal.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-color-api: Hidden — narrower craft-depth proof (OKLCH, k-means brand-color extraction). Risks over-weighting Bibel TV in the surface. Design-system-as-API already anchors the infrastructure signal.
selection_rationale.datameer-data-dense-analytics: Hidden — the CV references the 5-year Datameer director tenure + regulated-industry banking customer base + cross-Atlantic distributed-team methodology as the reliability-under-uncertainty proxy and international-fluency credibility floor. Portfolio surface stays focused on AI / agentic / model-adjacent work. Available under ?all for any reader going deep on the enterprise / data-dense / regulated background.
selection_rationale.spreadshirt-user-research-strategy: Hidden — 2014–16, predates AI-era work entirely. Not directly aligned with an AI Design Leader role. Kept under ?all for any reader going deep on strategic-influence history.

Verification log (goodmaven-ai-design-leader-verification.md, Q1 answer) is explicit: describe truthfully at internal-team scale (~CS team), foreground the design decisions (handbook-as-context, escalation-as-first-class, human keeps send-decision, qualitative adoption across the seniority-and-scepticism spectrum). Do NOT invent adoption / acceptance / override / CSAT numbers — none exist. Cover-letter carries the gap explicitly per Q1 answer: same product category, different scale.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.formal_evals_golden_set_regression_testi: No formal evals exist at Bibel TV. Q3 answer 2026-07-09 verified: self-tested for a week, then introduced through 1:1 sessions with the CS team. Adjacent methods only — qualitative-observation practice + experimentation-framework work on the mobile app + workshop curriculum covering evaluation of AI design decisions. All AI product work is prompt engineering + skill design + context-provision + agentic engineering. Portfolio foregrounds the fundraising ecosystem case study because it IS the closest 'moving closer to the model' proof he has (source-material analysis → prompt-engineering → prototype → shipped skill end-to-end, solo). Cover-letter handles the residual gap with the JD's own acknowledgment.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.multi_tool_autonomous_end_to_end_agent_a: Bibel TV CS copilot is single-step draft with escalation-as-first-class-output. Ninox vibe-coding is dual-path split-screen with suggested-actions chips. Fundraising Claude Project has multi-turn follow-up-question clarification loops before generation and multi-surface cascade in the Claude skill. These are real workflow design decisions but not the same as multi-tool autonomous end-to-end resolution at Fin's scale. Portfolio + CV describe architectures precisely; do not overclaim.
gaps_not_addressed_by_new_case_studies.all_staff_principal_team_management: Ninox was 5 ICs + 1 design lead + SLT member; seniority composition of the 5 is not fully documented (Priority 2 Q5 non-blocking). Portfolio + case-study framing stays at 'peer-in-craft management + SLT parity + coached the design lead through stakeholder conflict + made performance calls in both directions' per verification-log Truthfulness Guardrails.
